def apply_format_to_elements(list_, string):
    return [string % i for i in list_]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = apply_format_to_elements([1.234, 5.678, 9.012], "%.2f")
    assert result == ["1.23", "5.68", "9.01"]
    assert apply_format_to_elements(["temp1", "temp2", "temp3", "temp4"], "%s")[-1] == "temp4"
    print(result)
